Alice Nguyen: Heads up — saw a weird pattern during today's canary: if upstream service (payments) returns 500 during a pooled lease handoff, we sometimes get duplicate side-effects (double-charge). Repro steps attached below, short log snippets.
Ben Park: ugh. saw something similar last week in svc-payments. my guess: lease reassign triggers gateway retry path because idempotency header wasn't present.
Claire Ortiz: that matches my read. when proxy marks lease as failed it signals client to retry; if downstream already committed, you get double-effect.
Samir Khan: we should decide whether the gateway should swallow rollback/compensate or push strict at-most-once onto services via idempotency tokens + server-side dedupe.
Alice Nguyen: thought: add a short-lived header like `x-lease-inflight: <lease-id>:<req-id>` and have proxies refuse immediate retry on a new lease if they see commit marker for that lease.
Ben Park: feels brittle across multi-hop proxies. alt idea: write a small response trailer `x-proxy-commit: ok|pending|failed` so the gateway sees commit state before reassigning.
Claire Ortiz: trailers are nice but not universally supported by clients (mobile, some SDKs). and they complicate streaming. another option: async compensating callback from gateway to origin when it reassigns — messy.
deploy-bot: canary-deploy: ingress-gateway v2.4.1 rolled out to 12% — anomaly detector flagged 2 error spikes in the last 15m.
Samir Khan: short-term mitigation: 1) require idempotency header (or generate one at edge) for payment-affecting routes, 2) log/metric for `retry-reason=lease-reassign`, 3) disable auto-reassign for canary traffic until we have safer handshake.
Alice Nguyen: long-term: RFC for a lease-transfer handshake that includes commit-safe states: PREPARE -> COMMITTING -> COMMITTED/ABORTED and a small KV commit marker that proxies consult before retrying.
Ben Park: agree RFC. also add a debug flag in ingress to opt-out of auto-reassign during experiments.
Claire Ortiz: I'll prep a quick patch for payments to start sending `Idempotency-Key` and add server dedupe for 60s window.
Samir Khan: I'll start RFC skeleton for lease-transfer handshake and include tradeoffs (latency vs correctness, failure modes, streaming complexity).
Alice Nguyen: Action items summary: 1) Ben: add `retry-reason=lease-reassign` telemetry + debug flag toggle. 2) Claire: idempotency guidance + payments patch. 3) Samir/Alice: RFC for lease-transfer handshake + commit marker spec. 4) Ops: hold canary auto-reassign for 24h. I'll open tickets and link them here.
Ben Park: also, add a short log snippet pattern to search for: `lease.*reassign.*commit_marker_missing` — helps oncall triage.
Claire Ortiz: :thumbsup: will include that in the payments PR description.
Alice Nguyen: repro logs (sanitized): ```
[ingress] lease=lk_42 reassigning -> reason=upstream-500
[proxy] forwarding req id=rid_77 lease=lk_42
[upstream] payment commit ok tx=tx_9
[ingress] retry triggered new-lease=lk_43 req=idempotency-missing -> downstream duplicate
```
Samir Khan: good capture. let's avoid long-lived mitigation hacks. RFC should include a fallback where proxies can mark a request as "non-retriable" for a short TTL if commit marker present.
Alice Nguyen: thanks all — tickets incoming. ping me if you want to pair on the RFC this afternoon.
